// diagnostic

E0621

A script cannot have loose statements and an explicit `fn run`

What

A script cannot have loose statements and an explicit `fn run`

Why

The loose statements already define the script's one entry body, so a second entry would make execution order ambiguous.

Fix

Run `jet fix` to move the loose statements into `fn run`, or remove the explicit function.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0621: tests/ui/script_explicit_run.stderr.

Error [E0621]: a script cannot have loose statements and an explicit `fn run`
  --> tests/ui/script_explicit_run.jet:2:4
    |
  2 | fn run() { print("middle") }
    |    ^^^
 Why: a script's loose statements already form its one `run` body
 Fix: run `jet fix` to move the loose statements into `fn run`, or remove the explicit function
